{
  "opening_spine": {
    "pressure_source_type": "relational",
    "pressure_source": "Seren is abandoning the rehearsed wish in front of the whole assembly, spending her First Sacrifice on Lirael instead, and the presiding Dohkar is about to call out the misalignment",
    "hook_object": null,
    "opening_beat": "Seren’s voice falters mid-invocation, her hands trembling as she glances at Lirael instead of the offering, the practiced words dissolving into a blur of unspoken need.",
    "rising_beats": [
      "Lirael’s fingers tighten around the ceremonial sash, the fabric biting into her palms as she realizes Seren is not naming the wound—she’s naming *her* instead.",
      "Julian shifts at the edge of the gathering, his stillness breaking just enough to catch Lirael’s eye, his expression unreadable but his attention locked onto her."
    ],
    "decision_beat": "Should she let Seren’s sacrifice twist the wish into something unravelled, or tear off the cloth and speak the truth before the Dohkar does?",
    "pc_career": "Sacrificiant",
    "opening_setting": "Veilwood ceremony clearing",
    "environment_elements": [
      "the deep-crimson braided spiralgrass carpet, frayed at the edges where bare feet have trodden",
      "the pale mated-pair trees, their weeping-willow veils trembling in the dawn breeze"
    ],
    "interlocutor_placement": "Seren — the youth whose First Sacrifice she is supervising, her hands still shaking from the moment she looked away from the offering, her Veilweave clinging to her shoulders like a second skin.",
    "pc_self_presentation_beat": "opening — She adjusts the ceremonial sash, the embroidered thread catching on her knuckles, and knows the Dohkar will see it as hesitation, not fear.",
    "scene_want": "Wants Seren to name the wound plainly, even if it means Julian sees her like this—unsteady, exposed, and failing.",
    "scene_mission": "Stop Seren’s sacrifice from twisting the wish before the presiding Dohkar calls out the misalignment.",
    "reader_state": {
      "knows": "Seren is abandoning the rehearsed wish, Julian is watching from the edge, and the Dohkar is about to intervene.",
      "believes": "The cost of Seren’s sacrifice is Lirael’s unspoken wound, and the Dohkar’s judgment will decide whether the rite holds or breaks.",
      "wondering": "Why is Julian here, and what does he know about the sacrifice’s true target?",
      "must_not_confuse": "Seren is the one breaking the rite, not Lirael; the Dohkar’s authority is ceremonial, not absolute; Julian is an observer, not a participant."
    },
    "pc_body_callback": "opening — stress_tic (the ceremonial sash biting into her palms)",
    "li_body_callback": "beat 2 — focus_tell (the way Julian’s gaze lingers on her hands, as if he can see the sash’s bite through her skin)",
    "staged_characters": [
      { "name": "Lirael", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_PC_OPENING_FUSION" },
      { "name": "Julian", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" },
      { "name": "Seren", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" },
      { "name": "the presiding Dohkar", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" }
    ]
  },
  "scene_skeleton": {
    "character_plus": [
      {
        "character": "Seren",
        "mode": "IN_PERSON",
        "option_id": "OPT-4",
        "expression_mode": "CONCEAL",
        "first_mention": true,
        "visible_action": "She blurs the words of the invocation, her voice trailing off as she glances at Lirael instead of the offering, her hands hovering over the sacrifice like she’s afraid to touch it.",
        "behavior_object_ids": ["O5"],
        "behavior_person_ids": ["pc"],
        "revelation_bridge": "Her avoidance of naming the wound plainly reveals her belief that softening it is kinder than making it endure direct recognition.",
        "pc_lens_operation": "PERSONALIZE_SOCIAL_HARM",
        "pc_interpretation": "Seren is trying to protect Lirael by not speaking the wound aloud, but the Dohkar will see it as a failure."
      },
      {
        "character": "the presiding Dohkar",
        "mode": "IN_PERSON",
        "option_id": "OPT-8",
        "expression_mode": "CONTRADICT",
        "first_mention": true,
        "visible_action": "He interrupts Seren’s blurred invocation, his voice sharp as he demands the cost be spoken before the miracle, his fingers tapping the ceremonial sash like a reminder of his authority.",
        "behavior_object_ids": ["O4"],
        "behavior_person_ids": [],
        "revelation_bridge": "His insistence on the fixed order reveals his assumption that his judgment carries authority others haven’t earned.",
        "pc_lens_operation": "EMOTIONAL_CONCLUSION_BEFORE_EVIDENCE",
        "pc_interpretation": "The Dohkar will call out the misalignment, and his judgment will decide whether the rite holds or breaks."
      }
    ],
    "environment_plus": {
      "target": "the deep-crimson braided spiralgrass carpet",
      "axis": "use",
      "beat": "The carpet’s frayed edges bear the marks of bare feet trodden in haste, the braids loosening where Seren knelt too long, her hesitation pressing into the grass like a wound."
    },
    "pc_opening_fusion": {
      "character": "Lirael",
      "placement": "PC_FIRST_EMBODIED_BEAT",
      "character_angle": "Her grip on the ceremonial sash is the only thing keeping her from tearing it off—she knows the Dohkar will see it as hesitation, not fear.",
      "environment_target": "the ceremonial sash",
      "environment_axis": "ownership",
      "beat": "She adjusts the embroidered thread, the fabric biting into her palms as the Dohkar’s voice cuts through the clearing, sharp as a blade."
    }
  }
